description: Disposition register for proposal-marked thresholds per BRIEF-FUSE-1 §4.5

dispositions.notes: 10% fall in either underlying index triggers L6 HALT
One-session tracking deviation beyond 0.75pp triggers V1 NO-NEW-RISK
Five-session tracking deviation beyond 2.0pp triggers V1 NO-NEW-RISK
Forecast volatility at or above 2x long-run triggers V4 NO-NEW-RISK interlock

dispositions.source_status: OI-COST-3/4 venue items unresolved in U-01
dispositions.notes: Unresolved parameter; must be supplied as explicit synthetic input o5_collar in validated_inputs; absence produces fail-closed rejection outcome (order rejected, unresolved_fail_closed reason); rejections count toward third-rejection HALT per O5 semantics

unresolved_parameter_mechanics: An unresolved spec parameter is never defaulted in spec or engine. Where an evaluation needs such a value, it may arrive only as an explicit synthetic input inside validated_inputs (e.g. v5_tolerance, v7_spread_width, o5_collar); its absence produces that check's fail-closed outcome. The fail-closed outcome is NOT an unconditional NORMAL: unresolved parameters still trigger their row's specified action (V5 diagnostic trip, V7 order suppression, O5 rejection counting toward third-rejection HALT).
